info.title: API.SH: COS
info.description: The COS API from API.SH: public COS data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: COS stock per size (same as stock)
get.description:
The same answer as /cos/v1/stock: live online stock per size of one COS product in one market.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cos-availability

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A cos.com product link (its locale sets the market and language), the product's uri (name-colour-<10-digit article>), or a 10-digit article number.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: 10-digit article number (one colour of a product), instead of `url`, e.g. 1341040003.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Market: us (default), ca, gb, ie, de, at, ch, fr, es, it, nl, dk, no, se, pl, eu, eue, au, ww, or a site locale such as de-ch. Prices, currency and stock follow the market. `country` is accepted as the same thing.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The store's category menu for one market and language: each gender's featured links and sections with their links, every entry with its name as the site shows it, its link and the `category` path /cos/v1/category takes.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cos-categories

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Market: us (default), ca, gb, ie, de, at, ch, fr, es, it, nl, dk, no, se, pl, eu, eue, au, ww, or a site locale such as de-ch. `country` is accepted as the same thing.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of the market (e.g. de, en or fr for ch); default the market's first language.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every product in a COS category, with the same fields, sort, filters and paging as search. `category` takes the site's category path (a product's `main_category`, or a path from suggest's categories, e.g. women/womenswear/knitwear) or a cos.com category link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cos-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category path such as women/womenswear/knitwear, or a cos.com category link (e.g. https://www.cos.com/en-us/women/knitwear).

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Market: us (default), ca, gb, ie, de, at, ch, fr, es, it, nl, dk, no, se, pl, eu, eue, au, ww, or a site locale such as de-ch. Prices, currency and stock follow the market. `country` is accepted as the same thing.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names and texts, one the market offers (ch: de, en, fr; de: de, en; ca: en, fr; others their own). Default: the market's first language, or the link's.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: recommended (default), newest, price_asc, price_desc.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Colour filter, comma = any of (black, beige, blue, ...; values in `facets`).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size filter, comma = any of (xs, s, m, l, xl, 36, ...).

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Material filter (cashmere, wool, linen, cotton, ...).

parameters.name: fit
parameters.description: Fit filter (regular_fit, relaxed_fit, slim_fit, oversized_fit, ...).

parameters.name: product_type
parameters.description: Product type filter (cardigan, jumper, coat, ...).

parameters.name: feature
parameters.description: Product feature filter (classic_collar, collarless, ...).

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: women or men.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price, in the market's currency.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price (below this), in the market's currency.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Any other site filter as attribute:value (repeatable; a leading ! excludes), with attributes and values from `facets`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based). Pass `next_page` back; null on the last page.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Products per page, 1-48 (default 24).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Start at this product instead of `page` (`next_offset` of the previous answer).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One COS product in one market: name (and its English name), colour article and colour, price, original price and lowest 30-day price with the ISO currency (CHF, EUR, GBP, USD, ...), every size with its SKU and stock (in_stock, low_on_stock, out_of_stock), the other colours, description, fit, length, sleeve and neckline, composition and certified materials, supplier factories, size chart measurements, care instructions, categories, related products, images and the markets that sell it.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cos-product

get.description:
Customer reviews of one COS product in one market, as the product page shows them: the average rating, review count and fit, length and sizing averages, then the reviews (rating, title, text, date, reviewer first name, colour and size bought, fit answers, height/usual size/body type). Reviews belong to the style, so every colour shares them; each market keeps its own.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cos-reviews

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A cos.com product link (its locale sets the market and language), the product's uri (name-colour-<10-digit article>), a 10-digit article number or a 13-digit size SKU.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the reviews (default newest).

parameters.name: page

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, 1-50 (default 10).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the COS store: every product with price and the price before discount (value, ISO currency, label), the lowest price of the last 30 days, sale/new/in-stock flags, colour and the other colours, sizes, product type, materials, category and images, plus the site's filters with counts (`facets`). The site's sort and every filter it offers (colour, size, material, fit, product type, feature, gender, price range). Page with `page` (`next_page`, null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cos-search

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cos-stock

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
